title: Item link
description: An explicit parent/child relation between two source items (an item_links row). Parent and child must differ.

relation.description: links_to: a URL entity in the parent. quotes / replies_to: a referenced post. article: an X Article attached to the post.

position.description: 0-based order of the link within the parent (URL entity index for links_to, 0 otherwise).

locator_resolution.description: Which X URL-entity field gave the child's locator (unwound_url, expanded_url, or only the t.co url), or api_reference for a post referenced by id.

entity_status.description: HTTP status X reported on the URL entity, when present.
